payload.title: lift_sandbox_pin runs git with configuration that the seat's own tree chooses: a seat can point its worktree's .git file at a gitdir it wrote, whose config defines a clean filter, so 'git diff' runs the seat's command inside the kernel, outside any sandbox, before path admission refuses the pin
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:603-606 (the diff and the ls-files listing run in the seat's tree through hermetic_git)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:594-598 (the docstring names hermetic git as the protection for reading the tree)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/workspace_view.py:69-77 (hermetic_git strips the GIT_* environment variables and nothing else)
payload.rule_violated: The seat wrote the tree, so the kernel must read it as untrusted (D6 spec: untrusted seat output stays inside its boundary); a tool that runs configuration or attributes the tree supplies is not a read
payload.notes: Registered by the D6 findings clerk from the D6 review round 1 (lens security), re-checked at head ac106b734 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: The kernel reads the seat's tree without running configuration or attributes the tree chooses: for example git runs against a gitdir the kernel owns with a kernel-written empty attributes file, or the changed paths come from the sandbox runner and not from git in the seat's checkout. Test: the probe's scenario (the seat rewrites its .git file and adds a clean filter) leaves no marker file after lift_sandbox_pin, whether the lift is refused or returns.
